The Global Senior Commercial Finance Manager will lead complex financial analyses, develop executive-level reporting and performance frameworks, and influence business decisions through data-driven insights. This role is supporting our fastest-growing segment, with strong double-digit growth, with a strong focus on innovation and supporting cancer diagnostics through AI. The role will also drive standardization of commercial metrics, processes, and analytics across geographies while leveraging Danaher Business System (DBS) tools to support continuous improvement.

This position reports to the Senior Director, Commercial Finance – US Operations & Global FP&A and is on-site in Deer Park, IL.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
- Partner with global digital pathology commercial leadership to drive business performance and profitable growth, providing financial leadership across orders, revenue, funnel health, pricing, and profitability, while delivering actionable insights and recommendations that influence strategic and operational decision-making.
- Lead global commercial performance management, developing and maintaining executive dashboards, key performance indicators, and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into business performance across regions, product lines, and channels.
- Lead pricing, margin, and profitability analyses, partnering with commercial leaders to evaluate pricing strategies, customer investments, commercial programs, and growth initiatives while ensuring alignment with profitability objectives and continuing to drive double-digit growth.
- Partner with regional finance teams to establish consistent performance management methodologies, ensuring alignment of reporting, forecasting assumptions, metrics, and analytical approaches across the organization.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives, standardizing commercial reporting, enhancing forecasting accuracy, and improving decision-support capabilities across the business.

The essential requirements of the job include:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field with a preference of 8+ years of progressive experience in commercial finance, FP&A, business partnering, or financial leadership; OR a Master's degree with at least 6+ years of relevant experience.
- Demonstrated experience partnering with senior commercial and business leaders to influence strategy, drive financial performance, and support complex business decisions.
- Strong understanding of commercial business drivers, including orders, revenue growth, funnel management, pricing, profitability, productivity metrics, and market expansion strategies.
- Strong executive communication and presentation skills, including the ability to effectively communicate financial performance, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior leadership.
- Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, managing multiple priorities while driving results through cross-functional collaboration and influence.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience utilizing ERP, business intelligence, and performance management systems such as SAP, Power BI, OneStream, or similar platforms.
- CPA

jobs.description:

The Sr. Continuous Improvement (DBS) Engineer (P3) is a senior individual contributor accountable for improving operational performance across Distribution, Logistics, and Operations. This role focuses on flow, inventory management, logistics execution, and operational excellence (OPEX) through the application of Lean/DBS principles to design and implement system-level improvements across safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, and cost.

This role serves as a subject matter resource in logistics, distribution operations, and operational excellence principles while partnering with Trade Compliance to support operational alignment with regulatory requirements. The role translates business needs into structured action plans and drives execution through collaboration with Operations, Supply Chain, and frontline teams.

Working in close partnership with the Sr. Manager, Operations DBSL & Distribution, the Sr. Engineer supports operational improvements and drives execution across functions. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy within scope to evaluate processes, identify opportunities, and lead improvement initiatives. The role also provides broad exposure across Distribution, Logistics, and Operational Excellence, with opportunities to build expertise across multiple functions and lead cross-functional initiatives.

This position reports to the Sr. Manager, Operations DBSL & Distribution and is part of the Distribution team located at the US Distribution Center (USDC) in Torrance, CA and will be an on-site role.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
- Lead identification and resolution of gaps in operational flow across receiving, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and manufacturing processes to improve execution and support frontline operations; implement improvements that increase throughput, reduce lead time, improve quality, and stabilize execution through application of Lean/DBS principles.
- Serve as a key logistics and transportation resource within USDC operations; drive improvements in carrier performance, routing strategies, Incoterms, trade compliance alignment, and freight cost optimization through cross-functional partnership and execution.
- Drive improvements in inventory management, slotting strategy, and warehouse layout to support efficient flow and space utilization; improve inventory accuracy, FIFO adherence, location strategy, and reduction of unnecessary movement and congestion.
- Execute cross-functional operational improvement initiatives by defining problems, developing action plans, coordinating implementation, and delivering measurable operational results; apply structured problem-solving methodologies (e.g., PSP, Kaizen) to address root causes and sustain improvements through standard work & standard operating procedures.
- Analyze operational data across distribution, logistics, and operations using tools such as Power BI, D365, and Excel; translate data into actionable insights and reporting to support decision-making.

The essential requirements of the job include:
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering, or a related field required.
- 5 or more years of hands-on experience in distribution, logistics, warehouse, or manufacturing operations.
- Hands-on experience leading or executing operational improvement initiatives using Lean/DBS or similar structured methodologies (e.g., PSP, Kaizen, value stream mapping); strong planning, coordination, and execution management skills.
- Working knowledge of logistics operations including carrier management, Incoterms, and freight cost management; experience working within regulated environments and partnering cross-functionally to support operational requirements.
- Advanced proficiency in data analysis tools including Excel and Power BI; demonstrated ability to independently work with unstructured data to identify gaps, build structured analyses, and drive action.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:
- Ability to lift, move, or carry equipment up to 50 lbs.
- Must be able to stand, walk, and perform tasks on the warehouse or manufacturing floor for extended periods as needed.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
- Experience with ERP and distribution systems such as D365, AESDirect, XCarrier.
- Experience with inventory control practices including slotting, FIFO, location management, and space optimization.
- Related certification or formal training in Lean (e.g., Kaizen facilitation, value stream mapping) or supply chain and inventory management (e.g., APICS CPIM, CSCP, CLTD); hands-on experience preferred over credentials.

The Indirect Category Manager is responsible for developing and executing the category strategy for Facility & Equipment Services + Facility CAPEX globally for Pall. This role will support the Sourcing and Procurement of Facility Services including but not limited to equipment preventative maintenance, security services and systems, EHS related services, janitorial and groundskeeping. The role will also support Facility Capital Expenditures (CAPEX) including but not limited to new machinery/equipment, and facility/office upgrades, expansions, and space re-designs.

This position reports to the Sr. Manager, Global Indirect Sourcing and is part of the Strategic Sourcing team under the Global Integrated Supply Chain organization. This role can be located at our Deland, FL or Cortland, NY sites, or remotely within a reasonable commuting distance of either location. Candidates based in major metropolitan areas throughout Florida (including Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville, Miami, and Fort Lauderdale) or Central/New York regions (including Syracuse, Rochester, Ithaca, Auburn, Binghamton, and Utica) are encouraged to apply.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
- Lead strategy development for in-scope categories

- Partner with global stakeholders to implement and execute category strategies

- Identify cost savings and working capital improvement opportunities

- Work cross-functionally with Facilities, Operations, Engineering, Finance, and others throughout project identification & execution

- Solve problems and champion continuous process improvements for in-scope categories and throughout the business

The essential requirements of the job include:
- Bachelor’s degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field preferred, with 3+ years of experience; OR no degree with 5+ years of experience in Sourcing, Purchasing, or Supplier Relationship Management

- 3+ years of Indirect or Direct Sourcing & Procurement experience in a global manufacturing environment - Indirect strongly preferred.

- 3+ years of Category Management experience with Facility & Equipment Services, and Facility CAPEX projects

- 3+ years of Contracting experience including drafting, redlining, and negotiating with vendors and supplier relationship management

- 3+ years of Data Analytics experience in a Supply Chain related capacity, e.g. performing spend analysis for in-scope category management

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:
- Ability to travel up to 25% domestically & internationally, subject to business requirements

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
- SAP 4HANA or similar ERP system within Supply Chain related role(s)

- Supply Chain transformation initiative(s)

- Change Management, especially with internal cross-functional stakeholders and leadership

The Supply Chain Planning and Analytics Lead is responsible for integrating production planning, inventory strategy, supply chain analytics, and planning-system governance for the Westborough manufacturing site. This individual contributor role converts demand, capacity, material availability, and master-data insights into executable production plans and clear recommendations that improve delivery, inventory, and operational performance.
This position reports to the Senior Materials Manager and is part of the Materials organization located in Westborough, Massachusetts, and will be an on-site role.
What you will do:
• Own the site master production schedule and materials-planning process, including demand and capacity review, order management, and logistics, in order to improve customer delivery.
• Analyze inventory, working capital, excess and obsolete exposure, material availability, and production capacity.
• Establish and maintain planning and master-data discipline in Oracle, including planning parameters, lead times, planner assignments, and related controls required for accurate planning and execution.
• Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using Power BI, Excel, and other approved digital tools to strengthen visibility, decision-making, and accountability across the value stream.
• Lead cross-functional planning, analytics, and continuous-improvement initiatives with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Procurement, and Global Supply Chain, using Danaher Business System principles to improve flow, reduce risk, and standardize processes.
Who you are:
• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
• 3+ years of functional experience in production planning, materials planning, supply chain analytics, or inventory management within a manufacturing environment.
• Demonstrated experience developing operational analysis, metrics, or dashboards using Microsoft Excel and Power BI or comparable business-intelligence tools.
• Working proficiency with Oracle or other ERP systems for material requirements planning, planning parameters, work orders, and inventory controls.
• Experience translating demand, capacity, material availability, inventory, and master-data analysis into documented recommendations for cross-functional business decisions.
Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:
• Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, including possible overnight travel to other Cytiva or Danaher sites, suppliers, training, or workshops.
• Ability to work in an on-site manufacturing environment and enter production areas while wearing required personal protective equipment.
It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
• APICS or ASCM certification, such as CPIM or CSCP, or Lean or Six Sigma certification.
• Oracle Advanced Supply Chain Planning, Oracle Cloud planning applications, or comparable advanced planning systems.
• Danaher Business System, Lean manufacturing, daily management, problem solving, or structured continuous-improvement methods.

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity GRC Analyst (3 -4 years)
jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

This position of Cybersecurity risk manager and compliance analyst is for Beckman Coulter team located at Danaher India Development Center (IDC), Bangalore and an on-site role.
IDC is a research and development center with the vision of accelerating product roadmaps across various Danaher business segments. Started in 2014, the center now hosts 500+ associates, for multiple Danaher operating companies focusing on Diagnostics and Life Science. The operating companies includes Beckman Coulter, Radiometer, Leica Bio systems, HemoCue, Cepheid and more.
The IDC workforce comprises of various product engineering teams, working on development of software and hardware components of cutting-edge products for, Immunoassay, Chemistry, Hematology, Molecular diagnostics, Oncology, Neurosurgery and Water Quality. IDC has evolved as center of excellence for Cloud and data analytics, with significant contributions to the key informatics solutions. The teams consist of highly hardworking software & hardware engineers and development managers. The teams are supported by local Product managers, Quality & Regulatory and Intellectual property specialists.

If you thrive in a multifunctional role and want to work to build a world-class security into products from day one—read on.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
- Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive cybersecurity strategies specifically tailored for Research & Development (R&D) and product security.
- Ensure that these strategies align with the organization's overall risk management framework and business objectives.
- Collaborate with product teams to embed security measures from the initial design phase through to deployment.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams and provide guidance to ensure the effective implementation of security requirements across various departments.
- Continuously assess and incorporate cutting-edge cybersecurity technologies to strengthen the security posture of R&D operations.

The essential requirements of the job include:
- Utilize scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash to develop automated cybersecurity solutions.
- Focus on enhancing security testing, compliance checks, and risk management processes through automation.
- Configure cloud security settings and implement vulnerability management solutions to protect sensitive data and systems.
- Provide expert advice on security design principles and ensure seamless integration into existing systems.
- Stay informed about emerging trends and innovations in cybersecurity and evaluate their applicability to the organization.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
- Industry certifications such as CSSLP, CISSP, GIAC Secure Software Programmer, or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
- Familiarity with interoperability and healthcare data standards such as ASTM, FHIR, HL7 from a security perspective.
- Strong understanding of regulatory requirements related to product cybersecurity (e.g., FDA Premarket Cybersecurity Guidance, IMDRF, EU MDR Annex I).

- Familiarity with synthetic biology, organoids, and gene & cell therapy (CGT) with strong technical judgment.

- Understanding of capital markets with investment analysis and valuation capabilities.

jobs.description:
Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT) is the leading manufacturer of custom oligonucleotides and proprietary technologies for genomics applications. Our work is complex and cutting-edge, and our team members are curious, creative thinkers who understand that good data drives smart decisions. At IDT, we realize that although science may be uniform, people are unique. We promote a culture where engaged people are motivated and have opportunities to achieve their full potential, as part of one global team.

IDT is one of 10 Life Sciences companies of Danaher. Together, we accelerate the discovery, development and delivery of solutions that safeguard and improve human health.

This position is part of the Sales Department located in Paris area, France, EMEA and will be fully remote. At IDT, we are one global team. We celebrate our differences, engage in healthy debate, and are inclusive. Together, we accomplish great things.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
- Develops and manages assigned accounts strategically in order to deliver solutions and drive revenue growth

- Researches and understands territory growth opportunities for developing an effective business plan and sales strategy

- Maintains and develops strategic partnerships with key customers and leverages internal resources, when necessary, to achieve the highest level of customer satisfaction

- Builds in-depth knowledge of CRM and funnel management tools and applies these skills consistently to forecast business, manage customer opportunities, build opportunity pipeline, and make business decisions.  Maintains records and communications with customer base through CRM tool.

- Maintains regular and informative communications with all other team members, including cross-functional collaboration with Product Managers, Application Scientists, Inside Sales, etc.

The essential requirements of the job include:
- 5 years of prior sales experience required; preferably in life science reagents/consumables.

- Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets for at least 3 years is required.

- Residing in the assigned region and extensive familiarity with existing academic, corporate, and government accounts in the region is required.

- Applications experience within genomics, NGS, qPCR, cloning, mutagenesis , etc. and working knowledge of accounts in assigned territory preferred.

- Exceptional written, oral, interpersonal and presentation skills. Ability to effectively communicate with multiple levels of customers

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:
- Ability to travel – Around 50 % in the assigned territory

- Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
- In depth knowledge of SalesForce.com and working knowledge of PowerBI

- Outstanding prospecting, territory management, lead management, negotiation and closing skills. Ability to coach less senior team members as part of their development.

At IDT we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for IDT can provide.

Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT) est le leader mondial dans la fabrication d’oligonucléotides personnalisés et de technologies exclusives dédiées aux applications génomiques. Notre travail est à la pointe de la technologie et repose sur des projets complexes et passionnants. Chez IDT, nous valorisons les esprits curieux et créatifs qui savent que des données fiables permettent de prendre des décisions intelligentes.

Nous sommes convaincus qu’en science, tout peut être standardisé, mais que chaque individu est unique. C’est pourquoi nous promouvons une culture où chacun peut s’épanouir et révéler son plein potentiel, en contribuant à une équipe mondiale unie et engagée.

IDT fait partie des 10 entreprises Life Sciences de Danaher. Ensemble, nous accélérons la découverte, le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions qui protègent et améliorent la santé humaine.

Ce poste fait partie du département des ventes, basé à Paris /Ile de France pour la région EMEA, et sera entièrement en télétravail (Home Office).
Chez IDT, nous célébrons nos différences, encourageons des débats constructifs et plaçons l’inclusion au cœur de nos valeurs. Ensemble, nous accomplissons de grandes choses.

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de :
- Développer et gérer stratégiquement un portefeuille de comptes afin de proposer des solutions adaptées et générer une croissance des revenus.

- Identifier les opportunités de croissance sur votre territoire et élaborer une stratégie commerciale efficace.

- Construire et entretenir des partenariats stratégiques avec des clients clés, tout en mobilisant les ressources internes nécessaires pour garantir leur satisfaction.

- Maîtriser les outils de gestion CRM et de suivi des opportunités afin de prévoir l’activité commerciale, gérer les opportunités clients, alimenter un pipeline solide et prendre des décisions stratégiques.

- Collaborer régulièrement et efficacement avec les autres membres de l’équipe (chefs de produit, scientifiques d’application, commerciaux, etc.).

Les exigences essentielles pour réussir dans ce rôle sont les suivantes :
- 5 ans d’expérience en vente, idéalement dans le domaine des réactifs ou consommables en sciences de la vie.

- Un historique de performances solides , avec des objectifs de ventes atteints ou dépassés sur au moins 3 ans.

- Une excellente connaissance des comptes académiques, industriels et publics de votre région.

- Une expérience technique dans les domaines du NGS, qPCR, clonage, mutagenèse, etc., ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des besoins des clients de votre territoire.

- Des compétences exceptionnelles en communication (écrite, orale, interpersonnelle et présentation) pour interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés.

Ce poste implique également :
- Des déplacements fréquents (environ 50 % du temps dans votre territoire assigné).

- Un permis de conduire valide et un dossier de conduite acceptable.

Une expérience préalable dans les domaines suivants serait un atout :
- Une maîtrise approfondie de Salesforce.com et une connaissance pratique de PowerBI .

- Une capacité à prospecter, gérer un territoire, négocier et conclure des affaires avec brio.

- Une envie de transmettre vos connaissances et d’accompagner les membres moins expérimentés de l’équipe dans leur développement.

Pourquoi rejoindre IDT ?
Chez IDT, nous croyons à la construction d’un environnement de travail flexible et durable. Nous savons que le télétravail peut enrichir une carrière, et ce poste vous permet de travailler depuis chez vous tout en bénéficiant de défis stimulants.

At Radiometer, our vision is to improve global healthcare with reliable, fast, and easy patient diagnoses.

The Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships and Adjacencies is responsible for developing, managing and optimizing Radiometer’s global external partnership ecosystem that support portfolio growth, innovation and expansion into adjacent opportunities.

The role serves as Radiometer’s central point of coordination for strategic collaborations across diagnostics, digital health, and adjacent spaces, while ensuring strong governance, performance management, and value realization. Acting as the central interface between external partners and internal stakeholders, the Senior Manager enables seamless cross-functional integration and translates partnerships into scalable business impact. Through open innovation, structured partnership models, and continuous performance optimization, the role contributes  partnership and ecosystem insights that support portfolio decision-making and long-term growth priorities.

This role is focused on partnership enablement and value creation through external collaborations. The position concentrates on establishing strong partnership frameworks, governance, and ways of working that support the broader organization. The Senior Manager works in close collaboration with internal teams to ensure partnerships are effectively structured, managed, and deliver intended outcomes. This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional exposure and influence through partnership excellence.

This position reports to the Director, Strategic Portfolio & Innovation Management and is part of the Global Product & Portfolio Management team. The role is anchored at Radiometer’s headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark; other relevant European locations may be considered with regular travel to Denmark.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
- Manage and optimize a portfolio of strategic external partnerships across diagnostics, digital health, workflow solutions, and adjacent healthcare areas, ensuring strong performance, governance, and value realization

- Act as the partnership operating model owner by defining ways of working, KPIs, business review cadence, escalation routes, and decision inputs for key collaborations

- Connect external opportunities to portfolio and innovation priorities , ensuring strong linkage between partner activities, pre-TG0 opportunity maturation, strategic portfolio choices, and future growth spaces

- Build and maintain a targeted external innovation ecosystem , engaging with technology companies, startups, research institutions, and selected Danaher network opportunities in close collaboration with cross-functional teams

- Serve as the primary interface for selected external partners , creating alignment across R&D, Product Management, Commercial, Regulatory, Legal, Finance, Operations, and regional stakeholders

- Support partnership setup and lifecycle management , including opportunity evaluation, business case input, agreement structuring, contract support, launch readiness handoffs, and ongoing performance reviews

The essential requirements of the job include:
- Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Business, Economics, or equivalent experience

- Significant experience managing strategic partnerships, alliances, collaborations, business development opportunities, or external ecosystem relationships in a global setting

- Experience in healthcare, medical devices, diagnostics, digital health, or related life science environments is strongly preferred

- Demonstrated ability to work across matrixed organizations and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority

- Strong business acumen with the ability to assess strategic fit, value potential, risks, assumptions, and growth contribution of partnership opportunities

- Experience establishing governance mechanisms, performance metrics, decision forums, and partnership operating models

Key success criteria in the first 6 months:
- Establish a clear partnership operating model, including governance cadence, KPIs, escalation paths, and stakeholder interfaces

- Create an initial view of the partnership landscape, including strategic fit, value potential, risks, priorities, and recommendations

- Strengthen handoffs between external partnerships, innovation funnel activities, portfolio decisions, and execution teams

- Demonstrate early partnership value through improved transparency, decision quality, and alignment with Radiometer’s future growth priorities

Travel Requirements:
- Ability to travel internationally, including customer site visits, subsidiary support, and industry events

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
- Advanced degree (PhD or MBA), particularly in healthcare technology, product management, or market strategy

- Prior experience within acute care or point-of-care diagnostics

- Experience with Danaher Business System (DBS) or equivalent lean/continuous improvement methodology

- Knowledge of IVD regulatory frameworks (IVDR, FDA 510(k)) and their implications for product strategy

Application
We continuously assess candidates and invite them for interviews, so please don’t hesitate to send in the application.

We look forward to seeing your application.

The position concentrates on establishing strong partnership frameworks, governance, and ways of working that support the broader organization. The Senior Manager works in close collaboration with internal teams to ensure partnerships are effectively structured, managed, and deliver intended outcomes. This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional exposure and influence through partnership excellence.

This position reports to the Director, Strategic Portfolio & Innovation Management and is part of the Global Product & Portfolio Management team. The role is anchored at Radiometer’s headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark; other relevant European locations may be considered with regular travel to Denmark.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
- Manage and optimize a portfolio of strategic external partnerships across diagnostics, digital health, workflow solutions, and adjacent healthcare areas, ensuring strong performance, governance, and value realization

- Act as the partnership operating model owner by defining ways of working, KPIs, business review cadence, escalation routes, and decision inputs for key collaborations

- Connect external opportunities to portfolio and innovation priorities , ensuring strong linkage between partner activities, pre-TG0 opportunity maturation, strategic portfolio choices, and future growth spaces

- Build and maintain a targeted external innovation ecosystem , engaging with technology companies, startups, research institutions, and selected Danaher network opportunities in close collaboration with cross-functional teams

- Serve as the primary interface for selected external partners , creating alignment across R&D, Product Management, Commercial, Regulatory, Legal, Finance, Operations, and regional stakeholders

- Support partnership setup and lifecycle management , including opportunity evaluation, business case input, agreement structuring, contract support, launch readiness handoffs, and ongoing performance reviews

The essential requirements of the job include:
- Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Business, Economics, or equivalent experience

- Significant experience managing strategic partnerships, alliances, collaborations, business development opportunities, or external ecosystem relationships in a global setting

- Experience in healthcare, medical devices, diagnostics, digital health, or related life science environments is strongly preferred

- Demonstrated ability to work across matrixed organizations and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority

- Strong business acumen with the ability to assess strategic fit, value potential, risks, assumptions, and growth contribution of partnership opportunities

- Experience establishing governance mechanisms, performance metrics, decision forums, and partnership operating models

Key success criteria in the first 6 months:
- Establish a clear partnership operating model, including governance cadence, KPIs, escalation paths, and stakeholder interfaces

- Create an initial view of the partnership landscape, including strategic fit, value potential, risks, priorities, and recommendations

- Strengthen handoffs between external partnerships, innovation funnel activities, portfolio decisions, and execution teams

- Demonstrate early partnership value through improved transparency, decision quality, and alignment with Radiometer’s future growth priorities

Travel Requirements:
- Ability to travel internationally, including customer site visits, subsidiary support, and industry events

- Advanced degree (PhD or MBA), particularly in healthcare technology, product management, or market strategy

Senior Manager, Supply Chain – Newquay Site

What you’ll do
- Optimise performance of Supply Chain KPI’s (OTD, Past Due, Inventory, Material Availability, Warehouse performance) for Cytiva products, utilising structured data and expert deployment of Danaher Business System (DBS) to lead change improvement through the wider site Supply Chain Team.

- Maintain and agree Master Plan from S&OP monthly process and incorporate live Sales data to create a Firm Master Plan to drive Raw Material Requirements Planning, maintaining Master Planning data for all sku’s in conjunction with the PSI (S&OP) Lead.

- Lead the development of relationships, communication channels and performance improvements with key upstream suppliers and downstream supply chain partners and stakeholders.

- Organise and develop the supply chain team to best meet the needs of the business, providing mentoring, coaching and strong leadership to the Supply Chain team. Lead Supply Chain initiatives as part of the site leadership team with commitment to the use of DBS tools and techniques, collaborating both with on-site peers and Cytiva central enabling functions.

- Ensure the daily operation of Warehouse facilities are efficiently led, maintaining effective product flow in & out of the manufacturing plant, optimizing working capital through the use of DBS.

- Ensure optimized & efficient flow of FG materials through downstream sterilization, intermediate holding/release and distribution to regional distribution center.

- Lead excellent communication and teamwork between Supply Chain and Operations teams to ensure successful execution and attainment to plan for our Customers.

- Act with urgency and lead team(s) in effectively problem solving and resolve supply risks linked to raw material, manufacturing execution and FG distribution supply.

Who you are
- Masters or Bachelor's degree in relevant Business, Supply Chain, Engineering or Science based discipline, or equivalent years of experience.

- Seven years of progressive Operations or Supply Chain leadership in a high-volume manufacturing environment, ideally in Life Sciences or a similar regulated industry.

- Solid problem-solving skills- ability to resolve complex problems, communicate issues and propose solutions to both external customers and internal team members.

- High level analytical, presentation and interpersonal skills- able to communicate and present ideas in a way that produces understanding and impact that builds effective problem solving and ongoing relationships amongst peers and leaders.

- Ability to operate effectively in a multi-tasking, dynamic environment, while maintaining a forward-thinking and customer-first attitude.

jobs.description:

At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

The Payroll Tax & Compliance Manager serves as the regional authority for payroll taxation, statutory compliance, and regulatory governance across APAC. The Payroll Tax & Compliance Expert ensures payroll operations remain fully compliant with evolving local legislation, minimizes financial and regulatory risk, and provides expert guidance to payroll operations, HR, Finance, and leadership. This role strengthens payroll governance, audit readiness, and statutory accuracy across all APAC payrolls. This position reports to the Senior Manager of APAC Payroll and is part of the Corporate organization.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
- Ensure full compliance with country and regional payroll tax regulations across the APAC region and support the alignment of payroll tax processes with standardized workflows across the countries within the APAC region.
- Lead internal and external audits across multiple jurisdictions and manage responses to tax authorities. Oversee registration and compliance in new jurisdictions. Proactively respond to regulatory updates and ensure timely compliance.
- Drive consistency in tax procedures and documentation across countries. Track legislative changes across the APAC region and assess their impact on payroll tax operations.  Educate Payroll and other business departments on legal changes impacting Payroll and the business
- Manage relationships with payroll tax vendors and third-party filing agents. Monitor service levels, accuracy, and timeliness of filings.
- Collaborate with Payroll operations and IT to enhance tax reporting capabilities while supporting the implementation of tax automation tools and system upgrades.
- Partner with HR, Finance, Legal, and Compensation teams to address taxable benefits, equity, and executive compensation matters.

The essential requirements of the job include:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Business Administration or similar discipline or a minimum of 7 years of related payroll experience
- Minimum 5 years payroll tax experience
- Deep expertise in payroll tax, social security, and statutory payroll compliance along with strong multi‑country APAC payroll compliance experience
- Proven ability to lead regional tax initiatives within broader payroll transformation efforts.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
- Fluent in English required;  additional European languages highly advantageous  .
- Experience with regional payroll platforms.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to resolve discrepancies and optimize tax processes.
- Excellent stakeholder engagement across diverse cultural and regulatory environments.
- Proven ability to lead regional tax initiatives within broader payroll transformation efforts.

jobs.description:
At Aldevron, we shape the future of medicine by advancing science in meaningful ways. Our team of dedicated, forward-thinking associates share this goal by combining best-in-class products and service with the ideal operating environment to lay the groundwork for vital new discoveries worldwide. At Aldevron, we shape the future of medicine by advancing science in meaningful ways. Our team of dedicated, forward-thinking associates shares this goal by combining best-in-class products and service with the ideal operating environment to lay the groundwork for vital new discoveries worldwide. We believe people are our most valuable asset.

Aldevron is one of 10 Life Sciences companies of Danaher. Together, we accelerate the discovery, development, and delivery of solutions that safeguard and improve human health.

This position is part of the European Sales organization and will be based in Germany but is fully remote. You will be part of the EMEA Sales Team reporting to the Director of Sales, EMEA. As DACH region is a key growth market for Aldevron in Europe, you will be responsible for achieving orders and performance targets by developing new business opportunities, managing complex sales cycles and large (multi-million dollar, multi-year) deals, and building strong executive-level client relationships.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

- Goal Achievement and Performance Excellence: Consistently meet or exceed assigned orders goals, pipeline metrics, and other key performance indicators (KPIs) by maintaining high standards of client satisfaction and commercial excellence. This includes daily management of sales pipeline data in the CRM system, providing accurate and up-to-date forecasts, and exemplifying best practices in Value Selling and Funnel Management (including particularly CRM rigor).
- Business Development and Market Share Gain: Identify and develop new business opportunities aligned with the company’s long-term objectives, including gaining market share, launching new products and services, and diversifying Aldevron’s business within existing accounts. Leverage the complete Aldevron portfolio and Danaher connections to further penetrate existing accounts, and proactively identify and engage Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to drive growth.
- Complex Sales Cycle Leadership: Manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting to close, using a consultative selling approach to negotiate and close complex opportunities. Lead cross-functional teams, both internally and externally, to tailor solutions for clients, ensuring successful closure of deals. Coach and mentor team members in best practices for funnel management, prospecting, value selling and CRM discipline.
- Executive Relationship Management: Cultivate and sustain strong, trust-based relationships with key decision-makers and senior or executive leadership to influence buying decisions and foster long-term client loyalty. Serve as a trusted advisor, ensuring Aldevron’s value proposition is clearly communicated and aligned with client needs, and maintain a high level of engagement with stakeholders throughout the sales process.
- Peer Leadership and Continuous Improvement: Champion a culture of continuous improvement by leading, facilitating, and participating in relevant workshops and leveraging Danaher Business System (DBS) tools. Lead by example in sharing best practices, and mentor peers to help shape team culture, performance standards, and overall organizational excellence.

The essential requirements of the job include:

- Sales Experience : 7+ years in a client-facing sales role in the life sciences industry, with preferred experience in the biopharma industry selling into the cell and gene therapy client segments, with proven track record of being a top performer.  Proven end-to-end management of high-value deals ($1M+)
- Technical Expertise : Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific field. Deep technical knowledge of molecular and cell biology, with the ability to clearly articulate complex biotherapeutic workflows such as nucleic acids, gene editing, DNA plasmids, mRNA therapeutics, viral vector technologies, and ex-vivo cell therapy.
- CDMO/CMO Sales Background : Demonstrated success in sales roles with Contract Development and/or Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CDMO/CMO) supporting Cell and Gene Therapies, or equivalent experience.
- Peer Leadership : Proven ability to lead and align cross-functional teams without formal authority, driving collaboration to deliver results for clients and the business.
- Ability to travel up to 50% in DACH-region.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
- MS or PhD in a scientific discipline.
- Quantitative demonstration of consistent territory growth.
- Continuous improvement methodologies

The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is responsible for leading and driving the overall sales, market development, profitability, and strategic growth of the Medical business across the assigned region.
The incumbent will lead a team of Area Sales Managers to achieve revenue, market share, and profitability objectives while developing strong relationships with key surgeons, hospitals, institutions, channel partners, and healthcare stakeholders.
The role is responsible for developing and executing regional business plans, managing sales productivity, driving new product launches, enhancing customer engagement, and ensuring commercial excellence across Government and Private healthcare institutions.
The ultimate objective is to accelerate revenue growth, maximize market penetration, expand market share, and establish the company as the preferred partner in Neuro, ENT, Spine, Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery, and Microsurgical solutions and Ophthalmology segment

Key Responsibilities-

1. Drive Regional Business Growth and Commercial Performance
- Deliver regional sales, market share, profitability, and growth targets.
- Develop and execute annual and quarterly business plans aligned to organizational objectives.
- Drive performance across the Medical portfolio, including Neuro Surgery, ENT Surgery, Spine Surgery, Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery, Ophthalmology, Dental, and Clinical segments.
- Identify new business opportunities, growth segments, and market expansion opportunities.
- Ensure forecast accuracy, sales pipeline health, and achievement of regional revenue goals.

2. Lead Market Development and Product Adoption
- Drive adoption of new products, technologies, and solutions through structured market development initiatives.
- Support product demonstrations, clinical evaluations, and customer engagements to enhance product utilization.
- Monitor market trends and competitor activities, developing effective strategies to strengthen market position and business growth.

3. Build Strategic Customer and Stakeholder Relationships
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), leading surgeons, hospital management teams, government institutions, and procurement stakeholders.
- Partner with Marketing to execute product launches, promotional campaigns, workshops, training programs, and KOL development activities.
- Strengthen customer engagement and influence key decision makers to support long-term business growth.

4. Lead, Develop, and Inspire High-Performing Teams
- Lead, coach, and develop Area Sales Managers and regional sales teams to deliver business objectives.
- Establish clear performance metrics, KPIs, and accountability frameworks.
- Foster a high-performance culture focused on customer success, capability development, and continuous improvement.

5. Optimize Channel Partnerships and Operational Execution
- Develop and manage strategic distributor and channel partner networks to maximize regional coverage and performance.
- Resolve commercial and operational issues impacting regional business outcomes.
- Ensure effective collaboration across functions to deliver operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

Education
- Bachelor's degree in science, Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or related discipline.
- MBA in Marketing or Business Management preferred.

Experience
- 15 plus years of sales experience within Medical Devices, Capital Equipment, Surgical Technologies, or Healthcare Solutions.
- Minimum 5 years of people management experience leading regional sales teams.
- Experience handling Government and Private healthcare institutions.
- Strong exposure to channel partner and distributor management.
